evidence.notes: case=api66-body-caller66-database-default; API 66.0 body and API 66.0 caller: omitted database access is the positive system-mode baseline.
case=api66-body-caller67-database-default; API 66.0 body and API 67.0 caller: worker keeps its exact system-mode body default.
case=api67-body-caller66-database-default; API 67.0 body and API 66.0 caller: negative control must enforce user mode in the body.
case=api67-body-caller67-database-default; API 67.0 body and API 67.0 caller: omitted database access is the positive user-mode case.
case=api66-sharing-default; API 66.0 omitted class sharing retains the legacy baseline.
case=api67-sharing-default; API 67.0 omitted class sharing is the positive with-sharing default.
case=api67-trigger-database-user-mode; API 67.0 trigger keeps without-sharing context while omitted database operations enforce user mode.
case=explicit-user-dml; API 66.0 and API 67.0 statements use an exact explicit user-mode override.
case=explicit-system-dml; API 66.0 and API 67.0 statements use an exact explicit system-mode override.
case=api66-multiline; API 66.0 field, method, trigger, anonymous, and test bodies accept multiline strings without a version gate.
case=api67-multiline; API 67.0 field, method, trigger, anonymous, and test bodies accept multiline strings without a version gate.
